score_notes.christology: Christ alone. Presuppositional apologetics places Christ as Lord over all knowledge and reasoning.
score_notes.scripture: Inerrancy affirmed without compromise. Scripture is the self-attesting Word of God — ultimate authority.
score_notes.gender: Patriarchal. Durbin holds firmly to male headship in home and church. No women in pastoral or elder roles.
score_notes.leadership: Homepage identity focuses on mission/ministries; specific elder board and Durbin's role not detailed on home landing — prior research retained.
score_notes.soteriology: Reformed soteriology (doctrines of grace). Justification by faith alone. Clear gospel preaching.
score_notes.cultural: Durbin is one of the most culturally engaged pastors in America — active in anti-abortion ministry outside clinics, fights LGBTQ ideology, opposes CRT. Unapologetically counter-cultural.
score_notes.preaching: Expository with strong apologetic application. Apologia Studios extends teaching reach globally via podcast and YouTube.
score_notes.mission: Homepage confirms End Abortion Now national campaign, Red Door Ministry abortion-clinic outreach, and Apologia Studios gospel-centered media — highly active evangelism and cultural engagement verified.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Strong emphasis on men leading families. Church culture is distinctly masculine and confrontational (in the best sense).
score_notes.denominational: Reformed Baptist — confessional accountability with elder governance.

churches.assessment: Apologia Church under Jeff Durbin is one of the sharpest, most unapologetically Reformed and culturally engaged churches in America. Durbin combines expository preaching with presuppositional apologetics (Van Til/Bahnsen tradition), aggressive anti-abortion street ministry, and public debate against secularism and LGBTQ ideology. Apologia Studios is a major media platform. The church is small but punches far above its weight in cultural impact. GREEN across the board — this is exactly the kind of muscular, doctrine-driven, mission-active church MOOP celebrates.

churches.assessment: Covenant Bible Church is a Reformed Baptist congregation in North Georgetown (Austin metro area) planted and led by pastor-theologian Joel Webbon. The church affirms the 1689 Second London Baptist Confession — one of the most rigorous and historically grounded confessions in Protestant Christianity — placing it firmly within the Reformed, biblical-patriarchy, and expository preaching tradition. Webbon is a nationally known voice through Right Response Ministries, openly advocating biblical patriarchy (he explicitly rejects the 'complementarian' label) and Christian Nationalism. He has headlined panels on biblical patriarchy alongside Doug Wilson, Eric Conn, and Dale Partridge, and the church is networked with Church & Family Life (Scott Brown). He has generated controversy for some of his political/cultural commentary — men should evaluate this directly rather than through secondhand coverage. The church's theological foundation is solid: Trinitarian, faith-alone soteriology, male eldership, expository preaching, and Great Commission focus. The one caution is independence — no formal denominational structure means accountability rests on the internal elder structure. For men in the Georgetown/Austin area seeking a doctrinally serious, unapologetically patriarchal church, this is worth a visit. Personal note: Connected to Joel Webb (Webbon) referenced in USMC Ministries network.

churches.assessment: Eastside Baptist Church in Twin Falls, Idaho is a 1689 Confessional Reformed Baptist church with a plurality of elders, age-integrated worship, and a robust confessional foundation. Founded in 1972, this church holds to the full 1689 London Baptist Confession including the appendix on baptism. The elder-led structure (Thompson, Martinez) with deacons reflects biblical governance. Their adoption of resolutions on Freemasonry, age-segregation, and women's conscription demonstrates a church willing to take stands on cultural issues from Scripture — not hiding behind neutrality. Men's Book Study and age-integrated model mean men are formed as household leaders, not shuffled into a separate program. Four services per week (Sunday AM, Sunday PM, Sunday School, Wednesday evening) indicates a serious, committed congregation. This is an all-GREEN church — rare and worthy of attention for any Reformed Baptist in the Pacific Northwest.

churches.assessment: GraceLife Church Spruce Grove (Edmonton metro AB Canada) under Pastor James Coates is internationally known for a 2021 civil-disobedience stand against Alberta COVID-19 public-health restrictions. Coates was arrested February 2021, held in custody after refusing bail conditions, released March 22 2021 after pleading guilty + paying $1,500 fine; charges later DROPPED September 2023 after the Ingram court ruling found Alberta's public-health orders had been improperly imposed under the Public Health Act. The stand made GraceLife a touchstone for biblical-conviction-vs-state-overreach within North American conservative Christianity. Reformed Baptist; expository preaching; male eldership.

churches.assessment: Reformation Bible Church in Melbourne, FL is a Reformed Baptist, father-led, family-integrated congregation committed to the sufficiency of Scripture and the glory of God. Their motto — 'By the Gospel and for King Jesus… We Build. We Fight. We Conquer' — signals a militant, Christendom-oriented posture that aligns with the Right Response Ministries vision. The father-led structure is explicitly patriarchal (GREEN on gender — not merely complementarian). Family integrated services with potluck fellowship suggest a tight-knit covenant community. Friend Michael Pflugrad is connected through the Right Response Ministries Christendom cohort of 2025. This is the kind of church the MOOP directory was built to highlight.
